title: Choose the smallest execution model that fits
description: Select a workload and execution pattern. Then add only the state and output contracts the workload actually needs.

patterns.label: Direct model call
patterns.detail: One bounded transformation with no autonomous tool loop.

patterns.label: Deterministic workflow
patterns.detail: Application code fixes the order of retrieval, model, and validation steps.

patterns.label: Agent loop
patterns.detail: The model chooses which allowed tool to call and when to stop.

workloads.label: Route a support ticket
workloads.detail: Classify one message into a typed queue and urgency contract.
workloads.risk: A malformed label sends work to the wrong queue.

workloads.label: Answer from company policy
workloads.detail: Retrieve approved passages, generate an answer, and preserve citations.
workloads.risk: An unsupported answer can be mistaken for policy.

workloads.label: Investigate a refund
workloads.detail: Choose among read tools, ask for missing facts, and request a guarded write.
workloads.risk: A wrong or repeated tool call can create a financial side effect.

workloads.label: Process incoming invoices
workloads.detail: Extract fields, validate totals, and call a known approval service in fixed order.
workloads.risk: Silent schema drift can corrupt downstream accounting.
